fact: Togo First reports that the ANDF, created by decree on 18 September 2025, is to manage the land registry and develop a national land information system, with existing cadastre and land registration services continuing until transfer, and that since 17 August 2026 surveyors must submit parcel plans electronically through the OTR website.
title: Togo Names Land Agency Chief, but the Hard Part Is Still Ahead
